scope: Retrospective honest process inventory from this turn tool receipts. No process CPU-time or RSS samples were collected for earlier commands. Wall durations and exits remain in exec_command conversation receipts; no invented per-process measurements.

first_command.command: timeout8s python -I -B; sched_setaffinity(0,{0,1}); RLIMIT_CPU2; RLIMIT_AS512MiB; print limits applied

local_execution: Every local shell task was timeout-wrapped Python -I -B and set affinity to CPUs0,1 plus CPU and AS caps before file reads, parsing, HTTP, hashing or imports. All calls synchronous and returned exited; no process sessions or background jobs.
phases: entire TASK and ancestor AGENTS read
reservation/allowlist and narrow root metadata reads
stdlib HTML conversion and source passage reads
pinned snapshot and current metadata inspection
Nie terminal proof and digraph Theorem2.2 proof read
selected Zenodo ZIP text-member reads (no code execution)
source read inventory and passages write

failures.resolution: recorded; no retry or alternative bypass

managed_tools: web.run searches/opens and apply_patch text archival have managed limits, not local process telemetry. Their CPU/RSS/HTTP byte counts are unavailable. See managed-web-receipts.json.
deviations: An early reservation/allowlist print and some source excerpt outputs were larger than useful and tool output was truncated. Local reads stayed bounded; the exact data were preserved to disk. No claim that every downloaded manuscript was read in full.
Process inventory was finalized retrospectively rather than as an append-only launch-time telemetry log. No per-process CPU/RSS samples were captured.
jobs: All exec_command processes returned exit0 except the reaped missing-bs4 process exit1. No live jobs created by this lane.
